title: Card 9: login ke baad ginti user_id pe (JWT se). Ravi ki galti sirf Ravi pe padti

boxes.title: Gateway
lines: login se pehle: IP pe dheeli

callouts.red: Pehle ginti IP pe thi: Ravi ne had todi, poora office atka
callouts.green: Ab ginti user_id pe. Ravi ki galti sirf Ravi pe

callouts.red: IP ki had hi badha do (5 se 500)?
callouts.green: Office bach gaya, par botnet ko bhi utni hi chhoot mil gayi

callouts.red: 5 galat password pe account lock kar diya
callouts.green: Attacker jaan-boojh ke tujhe lock karega. Lock nahi, CAPTCHA

callouts.red: Kisi ki API key chori ho gayi
callouts.green: Nuksaan seemit, kyunki had key pe hai. Key badlo ya band karo

callouts.red: Had us pehchaan pe lagao jo ek insaan ki ho. Ek IP ke peeche 1000 log, ek botnet ke 1000 IP.
callouts.green: Login se pehle user_id hota hi nahi: tab IP pe dheeli had + WAF
